name: SDK test flow
description: Exercises buttons, an email question (input hint), a tag and a handoff. Starts when a visitor is on the home page.

welcome.name: Say hello
welcome.text: Hi! This is a test flow from the Dhaam chat SDK.

pick.name: What to try
pick.text: What would you like to try?

askEmail.name: Ask for email
askEmail.text: Sure. What email did you order with?
askEmail.retry: That doesn't look like an email. Try again, like name@example.com.

thanks.name: Thank them
thanks.text: Thanks {Email}! Our team will check your order and email you.

payTips.name: Payment tip
payTips.text: Payments sometimes fail when a bank double-checks. You haven't been charged.

done.name: Finish
done.text: That's it. Type any question and we'll help.
